page.title: Waiting for you
page.intro: Only things that truly need you appear here: decisions, shares, results to review, blocked work items, and runs that have failed. Everything that just happened can be found in the work item history and notifications.
page.emptyDescription: As soon as an agent needs a decision, a result is ready, or a work item is stuck, it will appear here.
page.emptySettledDescription: Whatever you answer here or whatever resolves on its own remains traceable in this list.
page.truncated: The list is truncated. Settle the top entries, and the next ones will move up.
